property_under_test: Prefix safety: no prefix of a longer train may emit an action. A triple must never produce a double plus a triple, and must never produce a double at all.

positive_controls.reason: separation 0.30 s is inside [min_separation_s, max_gap_s]; closes at 2.80 s
short but legal durations, separation 0.12 s just above min_separation_s
long but legal durations, separation 0.49 s just under max_gap_s
two independent pairs well outside cooldown_s

negative_controls.reason: single blink is never an action
triple; must not emit the leading double
separation 0.60 s exceeds max_gap_s; two singles, not a pair
separation 0.06 s below min_separation_s; one artifact, not two blinks
second duration above max_duration_s; likely a squint or artifact
inside warmup_s; baseline statistics are not established
second pair starts inside cooldown_s of the first decision and is suppressed with a reason
packet loss between the two blinks clears partial state and requires re-arm
signal quality failure suppresses new controls while music continues

reset_obligations: dropout, reconnect, quality failure, refit and model reload each clear pending candidates and require warmup before re-arm
a rejected sequence produces an enumerated reason, never a silent drop
a rejection is never retracted by a later emission for the same blinks
